## delightful-dragon

### Description and Rationale
I am an independent machine learning engineer based in Vienna, Austria, with several years of commercial experience building end-to-end production ML systems. My background includes tabular prediction, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, ranking, feature engineering, model evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. In the railway sector, I worked on predictive maintenance for infrastructure failures and IT risk forecasting. I am joining the challenge as a solo participant to apply this experience to airport operations, learn from real-world aviation data, and develop an open and reproducible solution.
